_note: Evasion attempt against a naive implementation. Subresource Integrity allows several space-separated digests in one field, so an equality test on the whole string ('sha512-BAD== sha256-anything' !== 'sha512-BAD==') would miss a tarball that is on the list. npm publishes a single sha512 today, which is exactly why this would go unnoticed until the day it did not. The known-bad token is second, so an implementation that only inspects the first also fails.
name: sri-list-evasion
